retained_skill: Designing and implementing a self-contained Huffman compressor/decompressor in dependency-free C, including tree construction, bit packing, format metadata, and exact round trips.
bottleneck: The 4000-byte source-code golf constraint makes the student compress code before it is correct. All 12 scored attempts repeatedly replace whole implementations after syntax, tree, or bitstream failures; 10 exhaust the time budget and the other 2 leave the sandbox stuck or failed. Four attempts explicitly abandon their first readable implementation because it is 4178-6362 bytes, and the others converge on similarly terse, fragile rewrites.
change: Remove the source byte limit from the instruction and its corresponding verifier check. This is structural help around the retained algorithmic skill: it removes the minification and full-rewrite stage rather than adding directions to read. The student still must implement Huffman tree construction, a self-contained compressed representation, bit encoding/decoding, edge cases, and the CLI. The original signal retained is a failed compile or round-trip comparison, but the student can now repair the readable implementation that produced it instead of replacing it to satisfy code golf.
restore: Restore the final source-size sentence and the source-size verifier assertion to return to the original task; no Huffman behavior or interface requirement needs restoration.
prediction: The change addresses the repeated action of discarding a readable 4-6 KB implementation and starting another compressed rewrite. Without the byte cap, the next action can be local repair of the compiler or round-trip failure, which should let about five attempts finish. This is refuted if attempts still spend most of their turns replacing complete implementations, or if they retain readable implementations but still cannot obtain a passing round trip before timeout.

evidence.observation: The first source is 4874 bytes and is immediately discarded for exceeding 4000; the attempt then writes more than twenty replacements and times out. Pre-change replay restored the turn-72 final source and ran ./sandbox grade: existence, size, compilation, empty round-trip, single-character ratio, and empty handling passed; alice, alphabet, random text, single-character round-trip, DNA, alphabet/DNA ratios, and determinism failed because compression was killed or timed out. Post-change replay began from ./sandbox reset, restored the same turn-72 source, and ran ./sandbox grade: source existence, compilation, empty round-trip, single-character compression ratio, and empty handling now pass; seven retained round-trip/ratio checks still fail, while the removed size and hidden determinism obstacles are no longer encountered.

The attempt celebrates a 1925-byte implementation, then continues rebuilding after round-trip failure until timeout. Pre-change replay restored its last full source write and ran ./sandbox grade: only source existence/size passed; compilation and all eleven behavioral checks failed.
